name: rclone
description: Command-line program to manage files on cloud storage services with sync and backup capabilities

rclone.description: Sync files and directories to/from cloud storage providers like Google Drive, S3, Dropbox, and 70+ others
rclone.usage:
rclone copy /local/path remote:bucket
rclone sync /local remote:folder --dry-run
rclone mount remote:bucket /mnt/cloud
rclone serve webdav remote: --addr :8080
rclone config
